title: SIH26054 Phase 4: Health Monitoring, Fault Injection, Uncertainty, and Prognostics Report

domain_qualification.telemetry_source: Controlled physics-based aero-piston digital twin simulation
domain_qualification.certification_status: Technical demonstration benchmark only. Zero claims of complete Rotax 914 OEM validation, FAA certification, or certified flight-test validation.
domain_qualification.health_score_meaning: Bounded engineering health indicator [0.0, 1.0] where 1.0 represents nominal operational baseline and 0.0 represents functional critical threshold (HI <= 0.35).
domain_qualification.uncertainty_label: Engineering uncertainty estimates derived from rolling residual dispersion. Not statistically calibrated Bayesian or frequentist coverage intervals.

scenarios.name: Nominal healthy cruise
scenarios.description: Unperturbed cruise condition at 75% throttle and 2000m altitude. Demonstrates false-alarm suppression and RUL withholding.
scenarios.prognostics_reason: Engine health condition is stable or non-degrading; time-to-threshold is infinite

scenarios.name: Gradual cooling degradation
scenarios.description: Progressive coolant heat exchanger fouling (40% conductance loss) starting at t=20s. Evaluates thermal lag detection and time-to-threshold.
scenarios.prognostics_reason: Engine health condition is stable or non-degrading; time-to-threshold is infinite

scenarios.name: Abrupt lubrication degradation
scenarios.description: Sudden oil pump pressure relief valve sticking (35% pressure loss) at t=15s. Evaluates step-fault detection delay and rapid decline.
scenarios.prognostics_reason: Engine health condition is stable or non-degrading; time-to-threshold is infinite

scenarios.name: Thermal load increase
scenarios.description: Multi-cylinder thermal stress from high sustained climb load at high ambient temperature. Evaluates thermal subsystem scoring.
scenarios.prognostics_reason: Engine health condition is stable or non-degrading; time-to-threshold is infinite

scenarios.name: CHT sensor drift
scenarios.description: Unilateral +0.8 °C/s thermocouple drift starting at t=10s. Other thermal channels (coolant, oil) remain nominal. Evaluates cross-channel discriminator.
scenarios.prognostics_reason: Engine health condition is stable or non-degrading; time-to-threshold is infinite

scenarios.name: RPM sensor bias
scenarios.description: Abrupt +150 RPM pickup bias offset at t=15s. MAP and fuel flow remain dynamic and uncorrupted. Discriminator isolates single-channel sensor bias.
scenarios.prognostics_reason: Engine health condition is stable or non-degrading; time-to-threshold is infinite

scenarios.name: Intermittent oil-pressure sensor dropout
scenarios.description: Sensor signal dropout (NaN injection) between t=20s and t=35s. Physical lubrication loop remains healthy. Evaluates missing-data handling.
scenarios.prognostics_reason: Engine health condition is stable or non-degrading; time-to-threshold is infinite

scenarios.name: Transient throttle disturbance
scenarios.description: 5-second throttle pulse (+15% throttle step from t=15s to t=20s), returning to cruise. Evaluates persistence counter and hysteresis recovery.
scenarios.prognostics_reason: Engine health condition is stable or non-degrading; time-to-threshold is infinite

scenarios.name: High-altitude/high-load cruise
scenarios.description: Sustained high cruise load (85% throttle) at 3500m altitude. Confirms physics baseline accommodates legitimate operational workload without false alarms.
scenarios.prognostics_reason: Engine health condition is stable or non-degrading; time-to-threshold is infinite
